review.note: M52: written to carry the middle of CShapes’ gwcode 365, which held three polities under one label. Its dates are Wikidata’s Q15180: P571 1922-12-30, the normal-rank value — the 1923-07-06 inception, the constitution, is deprecated there — and P576 1991-12-26. Nine of its nineteen periods begin before 1922 and are flagged m52-gap: CShapes draws entity 365 continuously across those years and whose ground it was is open. See docs/m52-russia.md.

sources.locator: Q15180, P571 1922-12-30 (normal rank; the 1923-07-06 value is deprecated)

summary: A polity whose inception Wikidata states as 1922-12-30 on Q15180 and whose dissolution it states as 1991-12-26. The same item carries a second inception, 1923-07-06, and that value is deprecated there, so this record takes the first and says so. Its name is the one CShapes’ own label for entity 365 — "Russia (Soviet Union)" — carried, and its territory is that entity’s: the dataset draws 24 periods for it between 1886 and 2019 under a single label covering three polities, and M52 gave this record the nineteen that run from the Russian Empire’s last period to 1991-12-20. Nine of those nineteen begin before 1922. CShapes draws that ground continuously and Wikidata names no polity holding it, so they are carried here and flagged rather than assigned to a record invented for them.
